notes: Speed Queen TR7 top-load washer with a belt and a variable-speed 1 HP motor. Most part numbers match the TR3 record and the control assembly differs; the manual also covers 115 and 119 variants with other parts, and the mixing valve and out-of-balance switch change at a serial number.

gaps: The drive control list on printed p.39 (PDF p.41) is headed for the AWN43, AWN63, FWN, LWN and ZWN models and does not name AWNE9RSN116TW01; its 'all other models' entry (203657P) is not read as applying here. Only the list on printed p.35 (PDF p.37), which names AWNE9RSN116TW01, is claimed.
The 1 HP variable-speed rating is from the spec sheet (TR7003WN column); the parts list gives the motor's part number only. Whether the motor is AC or DC is not given, so no ac flag is set.
Volts, amps and watts are left blank: the parts list gives part numbers only.
Lid lock kit 205222 is read from the 'all other models' line, because this model is not named in the 205791 entry.
The mixing valve is mapped to valve_solenoid by function and the lid lock kit to solenoid_actuator by function; the list does not name solenoids.
Serial changes: mixing valve at 1812016077, out-of-balance switch at 1906000001; both are given as the list states them.
method: Speed Queen spec sheet AR20-0032 (2020), hosted by AJ Madison and carrying Speed Queen's own branding; page rendered. Its Model No. row ties product code TR7003WN to AWNE9RSN116TW01, and the 'Variable Speed, 1 HP Motor' row is marked under TR3, TR5 and TR7.
Alliance Laundry parts manual 204240R12, Residential and Non-Vend Topload Washers (October 2025): model list on printed p.3 includes AWNE9RSN116TW01.
Printed pages used (printed page = PDF page minus 2): control assembly p.11, lid switch p.13, lid lock p.15, fill hose, mixing valve and pressure sensor p.17, motor and belt p.19, washtub p.21.
More printed pages: springs and out-of-balance switch p.23, drain pump and hoses p.25, weldment, shaft and pulley p.27, lead-in cord p.31, output board p.35, drive control p.39.
Drawings are images; part numbers come from the lists beside them (control assembly and both drive control pages rendered and read).

comps.spec: Motor, Speed Queen part 204556P, listed for AWNE9RSN116TW01. Speed Queen's spec sheet gives the TR7003WN a variable-speed 1 HP motor.
Belt, part 204690, in the motor, mounting bracket and belt section.
Drive pulley, part 204667, in the weldment, bearing, drive shaft and pulley section, with drive shaft 204901.
Pump and bracket, part 203885, in the drain pump, drain hose and siphon break section.

Drive control assembly, part 204659P, listed for AWNE9RSN116TW01 (also AWNE9RSN116TB01 and ZWNE9RSN116CW01) in the output board, wire harnesses and wires section. The control drive harness 204715 is listed on the same page.
Control assembly, part 204852, listed for AWNE9RSN116TW01 in the graphic panel, control support panel and controls section. The list says it includes item 6, the overlay.
Lid switch kit, part 204696. The list gives separate screws for single and dual switches.
Lid lock kit, part 205222, listed under all other models than the 119 variants. The list says it includes lid lock bezel 203643. A separate lid lock catch, 203573, is listed.
Out-of-balance switch assembly, part 803415 through serial 1905999999 or part 807384 from serial 1906000001.
Mixing valve, part 205547P through serial 1812016076, with dual filter mixing valve kit 205765 from serial 1812016077. It is listed in the fill hose section.
Pressure sensor, part 203843, listed in the fill hose and mixing valve section.
Fill hoses, 4 feet: part 203719 marked for hot water (red) and part 203720 marked for cold water (blue).
Drain hose, part 203588, and tub-to-pump hose, part 203560.
Lower bearing, part 28944RP, listed in the weldment and bearing assembly section beside weldment and bearing assembly 39253.
Stainless steel washtub kit, part 719P3, with washtub gasket 39122.
Leg spring, part 37575, painted blue: four rear springs and two front springs. Green-painted front springs have to be replaced in pairs.
